scope: Local APIC registers for a Linux-like probe: Version, LINT0/LINT1, Error LVT, ESR, DFR/LDR (storage only, no delivery sources)
source: Intel 64 and IA-32 SDM release 093, Volume 3A Chapter 13

registers.esr_0x280: write latches accumulated log and clears it, read returns latch, no error source
registers.dfr_0xe0: reset 0xffffffff, model nibble 0xf/0x0 stored, no routing
registers.ldr_0xd0: reset 0, logical ID stored, no routing
registers.perf_thermal_cmci: not added: 0x340/0x330/0x2f0 stay UnknownOffset; CPUID must not advertise PMU, TM, CMCI

checks.full: cargo test -p od-machine --offline: 19 test result lines, all ok, 0 failed

limitations: no LINT pin delivery, NMI/SMI/INIT/ExtINT, Error LVT delivery or ESR error sources
Fixed LINT vector below 16 is not validated: nothing is delivered
DFR/LDR are storage only, no logical destination routing
CPUID consistency, x2APIC, multi-CPU, IOAPIC S4-26c, CPU delivery and Linux acceptance (S4-38) are out of scope
